dataset.split_policy: Publisher val reserved as test; remove training source-photo/pixel overlaps with test; split remaining train by source-photo ID into train/val; remove pixel overlap with val. Exclude augmentation-suffixed files.
dataset.image_processing: RGB PNG resized to 96x96 for small demo upload
dataset.group_definition: Filename date and DJI image identifier before _cadeia_isolador_vidro_
dataset.limitations: Source-photo IDs checked; independence of adjacent flight frames, physical assets and capture sessions is not verified. Small demo, not deployment accuracy. Publisher val is repurposed as held-out test; not the original benchmark protocol.

note: Small grouped demo subset; no verified flight-session or physical-asset independence. HOG model is used by the existing website; CNN weights are comparison evidence only.
